connector.name: RZD Tickets MCP
connector.registryDescription: Read-only MCP server for RZD trains, cars, seats, adjacent pairs and car photos.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-rzd-tickets. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the ex3lite account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
